key_grammar.source_sentence: Capitalism is not a system where cash is everywhere but rather one in which islands of cash exchange exist within oceans of cheap―or potentially cheap―natures.

explanation.text: 'in which'는 '전치사 in + 관계대명사 which'가 합쳐진 형태로, 뒤 절을 앞 명사(one=a system)에 연결한다.
원래 'islands ... exist in one(=a system)'에서 전치사 in이 관계대명사 which 앞으로 이동한 것.
앞의 'a system where cash is everywhere'의 where도 in which로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다(관계부사=전치사+관계대명사).
in which 뒤에는 'islands of cash exchange exist'라는 주어·동사를 갖춘 완전한 절이 온다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 선행사 one(=a system)을 수식하며, 전치사 in이 관계대명사 which 앞으로 나온 구조.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: Capitalism is not a system [[1|where]] cash is everywhere [[2|but]] rather one [[3|in which]] islands of cash exchange [[4|exists]] [[5|within]] oceans of cheap―or potentially cheap―natures.
drills.fix: 주어 islands(복수)에 맞춰 동사는 exist가 옳다; exists는 수 일치 오류.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: The climate changes, and crops can no longer [[grow/to grow]] [[as/so]] abundantly as they once [[did/were]].
drills.fix: 조동사 can 뒤에는 원형 grow, 원급 비교는 as ~ as, 앞의 grow를 대신하는 대동사는 did.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: Workers demand dignity, and their labor become expensive.
drills.fix: their labor(단수 주어)에 맞춰 become → becomes.
options: Reproducing life within the cash nexus is expensive, and it grows more expensive over time.
Production processes burn through an island, and energy is no longer cheap.
Workers demand dignity, and their labor become expensive.
The climate changes, and crops can no longer grow as abundantly as they once did.
Frontiers are so important in these processes because they offer places where the new cheap things can be seized―and the cheap work of humans and other natures can be forcefully taken.

sentences.english: Capitalism is not a system where cash is everywhere but rather one in which islands of cash exchange exist within oceans of cheap―or potentially cheap―natures.

grammar.note: in one(=a system)에서 in이 관계대명사 앞으로 이동

chunks.en: Capitalism is not a system
where cash is everywhere
but rather one in which
islands of cash exchange exist
[[within oceans of cheap―or potentially cheap―natures.]]

misreads.statement: 자본주의는 현금이 도처에 존재하는 체제가 아니라, 값싼 자연의 바다에 현금 교환의 섬들이 떠 있는 체제로 묘사된다.
자본주의는 현금 교환의 섬들 속에 값싼 자연의 바다가 들어 있는 체제다.
misreads.anchor: islands of cash exchange exist within oceans of cheap―or potentially cheap―natures
misreads.why: 현금의 섬이 값싼 자연의 바다 '속에' 존재하는 것이지 그 반대가 아님.

mistips: not A but rather B: 'A가 아니라 오히려 B'로 해석
one = a system (앞 명사를 대신하는 부정대명사)

sentences.english: Reproducing life within the cash nexus is expensive, and it grows more expensive over time.

chunks.en: Reproducing life within the cash nexus is expensive,
chunks.ko: 현금 관계 속에서 삶을 [[재생산]]하는 일은 비싸고,

chunks.en: and it grows more expensive over time.

misreads.statement: 두 번째 문장의 it은 '현금(cash)'을 가리키며, 현금 자체가 시간이 갈수록 비싸진다는 뜻이다.
misreads.anchor: Reproducing life within the cash nexus is expensive, and it grows more expensive over time.
misreads.why: it은 '현금 관계 속에서 삶을 재생산하는 일'을 가리킴.

sentences.english: Workers' wages can be frozen, even rolled back, but in the end inequality leads to crises of the kind we've recently seen bring about populist protests in the United States and the United Kingdom.

chunks.en: Workers' wages can be frozen, even rolled back,
chunks.ko: 노동자의 임금은 동결되거나, 심지어 [[삭감]]될 수도 있지만,

chunks.en: but in the end inequality leads to crises
of the kind we've recently seen
bring about populist protests
in the United States and the United Kingdom.

misreads.statement: 임금은 동결되거나 삭감될 수 있지만, 결국 불평등은 미국과 영국에서 목격한 것과 같은 위기를 낳는다.

sentences.english: Workers demand dignity, and their labor becomes expensive.

chunks.en: Workers demand dignity,
and their labor becomes expensive.

misreads.statement: 노동자들은 존엄을 요구하며, 더 긴 근무 시간을 통해 임금을 보전하려 한다.
misreads.anchor: Workers demand dignity, and their labor becomes expensive.
misreads.why: 근무 시간 연장은 지문에 없는 정보이며, 노동이 비싸진다고만 함.

misreads.statement: Workers' labor becomes expensive when they demand dignity.

sentences.english: Production processes burn through an island, and energy is no longer cheap.

chunks.en: Production processes burn through an island,
and energy is no longer cheap.

misreads.statement: 생산 과정이 자원의 섬을 소진하여 에너지가 더는 값싸지 않게 되는데, 이는 노동자들이 존엄을 요구했기 때문이다.
misreads.anchor: Production processes burn through an island, and energy is no longer cheap.
misreads.why: 에너지가 비싸진 것은 섬(자원)을 소진했기 때문이지 임금 요구 때문이 아님.

sentences.english: The climate changes, and crops can no longer grow as abundantly as they once did.

misreads.why: 작물이 예전만큼 '더 이상' 풍성히 자랄 수 없다고 함(반대).
